papers.title: Comparative study of the influence of tool diameter on axial tool wear, cavity formation, and surface integrity in electro discharge drilling of Ti–6Al–4V
papers.abstract: Electro discharge drilling (EDD) is widely used for producing deep, high-aspect-ratio holes in difficult-to-machine materials such as Ti-6Al-4V. However, excessive tool wear, limited cavity depth, and poor surface integrity remain major challenges, particularly with small-diameter electrodes. This study investigates the influence of tool diameter on EDD performance using tubular copper electrodes of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7 mm diameter. The effects of discharge current, pulse-on time, pulse-off time, and capacitance were evaluated using the single-factor-at-a-time method. Material removal rate (MRR), tool wear rate, axial tool wear, cavity depth, and surface roughness were used to assess machining performance. Increasing discharge energy improved MRR but also increased tool wear and surface roughness. The effect of tool diameter on MRR depended on the discharge parameter: the 0.3 mm electrode produced the highest MRR under current and pulse-off time variations, whereas the 0.5 mm electrode achieved higher MRR under several pulse-on time and capacitance conditions. In contrast, the 0.7 mm electrode produced the deepest cavities (8.5−9.0 mm), lower axial tool wear, and superior surface integrity under moderate discharge conditions. Optical profilometry and scanning electron microscopy revealed debris adhesion and micro-crack formation under high-energy machining conditions. The results demonstrate that optimum EDD performance requires an appropriate combination of discharge parameters and tool diameter rather than maximizing discharge energy alone.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究电火花钻孔对Ti-6Al-4V的加工性能，但未涉及增材制造或后处理对疲劳/力学性能的影响，与该方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper concerns electro discharge drilling of conventional Ti-6Al-4V, not additive manufacturing, and it does not evaluate post-processing effects on fatigue or mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究电火花钻孔中电极直径对加工效率和表面质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用0.3、0.5、0.7mm铜电极，通过单因素实验评估放电参数对MRR、磨损和表面粗糙度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 0.7mm电极产生更深孔腔、更小磨损和更好表面，而0.3mm电极在部分参数下MRR最高。
summary_zh.validation: 使用光学轮廓仪和扫描电镜观察表面缺陷与显微裂纹。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the influence of tool diameter on machining efficiency and surface quality in electro discharge drilling of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Tubular copper electrodes of 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7 mm diameter were used with a single-factor method to evaluate the effects of discharge parameters on MRR, tool wear, and surface roughness.
summary_en.result: The 0.7 mm electrode produced deeper cavities (8.5–9.0 mm), lower axial tool wear, and superior surface integrity, while the 0.3 mm electrode achieved higher MRR under certain current and pulse-off time conditions.
summary_en.validation: Surface integrity and defect formation were characterized using optical profilometry and scanning electron microscopy.
